methodology_breaks.note: From August 2021, MNRE began counting off-grid renewable installations (rooftop solar < 1 MW, small-scale wind, biogas) in the all-India installed-capacity total. Earlier vintages reported only grid-connected plants >= 25 MW. The series jump is approximately +12 GW in the renewable-capacity total nationally; comparing pre-2021-08 to post-2021-08 figures overstates the growth rate. See ADR-0030 D33.8 for the compute-on-read parent invariant — yen-gov does NOT emit a `_total_mw` parent that would mask this break inside an aggregate.

From FY 2021-22 (April 2021 onwards), CEA's per-state coal-capacity column folds in bagasse cogeneration plants below 25 MW that were previously reported under 'renewable - biomass'. State-level coal totals for sugar-belt states (UP, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu) may be 1-3% higher from FY22 onwards than pre-FY22 figures, with a matching deduction from renewable-biomass. This is a reclassification, not a real capacity change. Sister rule to mnre-offgrid-inclusion-2021-08 but at a different (CEA, not MNRE) seam.
